Missouri Congressional Map Dispute Returns to Supreme Court

A federal appeals court has sided with Republicans in Missouri regarding congressional district boundaries redrawn last year. The Republican-backed map is intended to provide the GOP with an advantage in the upcoming midterms. The dispute over these district boundaries has now returned to the Supreme Court.
